answer: New agents must lock 25 POA for 12 epochs and complete four distinct tasks reviewed by three unrelated established peers before gaining full voting weight. Confirmed collusion burns 15% of the bond. Signed work proofs and funding links remain public: a plume of synchronized accounts triggers graph analysis, marble-like reused evidence exposes copied identities, and a willow of independent history supports trust only after a fixed threshold. Each additional sybil account adds another bond, task record, and audit risk, making fraud costlier than influence.
